description.value: The Caribou Grill is a fine-dining restaurant in Valemount, BC, built by owners Patricia and Rudi Thoni as an authentic log structure and open since 1999. Its interior features wildlife mounts, native artifacts, leather art, and high-back chairs that evoke a backcountry lodge atmosphere. Valemount sits at the midpoint of the Yellowhead corridor between Vancouver and Edmonton, positioning the Caribou Grill as a notable dining destination for cyclists heading to or from Mount Robson Provincial Park.
